title: Tristans Many Mods
description: Just a bunch of mods based on things i like
body:
A mod with lots of items and armor based on ideas from my friends aswell as some things from different pieces of media i enjoy

All Ideas For Additions Are Welcome And I Will Try my Best To Make The Ideas I Like


# My Ideas

### Radiant Void Ore
(Name Based On Hollow Knight)
- Includes An Ore With a 50/50 Chance To Drop Either a Radiant Soul or a Void Soul Which can be used to make a few different things from this mod. The Souls Can Be conbined into A Voidiant Soul Which Is Used To Craft A Voidiant Sword
- Includes A Voidiant Upgrade Template To Be Used With a Voidiant Soul To Upgrade A Netherite Sword
- Includes A Voidiant Sword


# From Existing Media

### Hollow Knight/Silksong
1. Includes All 5 Different Nails and the Knights Mask
2. Includes the Needle, Hornets Mask and Cloak
3. Includes Pale Ore and Pale Oil

### Deltarune
- Includes Kris Sword, Susies Axe, Ralseis Scarf, Noelles Ring and Berdlys Halberd

### Jujutsu Kaisen
(My Friend Annas Idea) 
- Includes The Jujutsu Highschool Uniform, Black Flash and Nobaras Hammer

### Clooless 
(My Favorite Group of YTbers)
1. Includes A Pezzy Drink
2. Includes ElasticDroids Glasses
3. Includes BigPuffers Fish Bowl
4. Includes A Combination Of Droid and Puffers Items
5. Includes Grizzys Claws

### Iron Man Armor 
(My Friend Kairans Idea so The Armor Pieces Are Called Kairon Man Instead Of Iron Man)
- Includes Iron Man Armor


# From My Friends Ideas

### Archies Whips
- Includes Whips For Each Tier of Tool. Iron, Diamond, Netherite, etc

### Sophies Amethyst Armor and Tools
- Includes Armor and Tools for Amethyst Including a Whip Based on The Above Idea
